preconditions.description: The number of test cases is between 1 and 10, inclusive.
The number of friends and the number of roads are between 2 and 10^5, inclusive.
The number of roads is between N-1 and N*(N-1)/2, inclusive.
The road connections are between 1 and 10^9 in length.
The road number K is between 1 and M, inclusive.

postconditions.expression: Output is two space-separated values rounded to 5 decimal places
postconditions.description: The output consists of the distance from point A on the Kth road and the maximum of all shortest distances from P to all friends' houses.
